title: Local Storage
definition: LocalStorage provides 5-10MB of persistent, synchronous key-value string storage in the browser. It survives tab closures and browser restarts. It is vulnerable to XSS.
simpleExplanation: A permanent digital notebook in your browser. But remember, anything written here can be read by ANY script running on the page.
